lines.en: The Bird and the Whale
lines.zh: 鸟和鲸鱼

lines.en: (An original tale by The
lines.zh: （原创故事

lines.en: Once there was a bird who fell in love with a whale.
lines.zh: 从前有一只鸟，爱上了一头鲸鱼。

lines.en: And a whale who fell in love with a bird.
lines.zh: 还有一头鲸鱼，爱上了一只鸟。

lines.en: The bird loved the whale's beautiful smile.
lines.zh: 鸟喜欢鲸鱼美丽的笑容。

lines.en: He loved the way she swam through the water so gracefully.
lines.zh: 他喜欢她在水里游得那么优雅的样子。

lines.en: The whale loved the bird's handsome white feathers.
lines.zh: 鲸鱼喜欢鸟那一身漂亮的白色羽毛。

lines.en: She loved to watch him soar through the sky.
lines.zh: 她喜欢看他翱翔在天空里。

lines.en: And they both loved to eat lots of tiny fish.
lines.zh: 而且他们都爱吃好多好多小鱼。

lines.en: All summer, the bird and the whale met in the bay.
lines.zh: 整个夏天，鸟和鲸鱼都在海湾里见面。

lines.en: They talked and talked.
lines.zh: 他们说啊说。

lines.en: They talked about the moon, and the stars, and the ships on the ocean.
lines.zh: 他们聊月亮，聊星星，聊海上的船。

lines.en: The bird told jokes and made the whale laugh.
lines.zh: 鸟讲笑话，逗得鲸鱼哈哈大笑。

lines.en: The whale sang beautiful songs that made the bird cry (even though he didn't know why).
lines.zh: 鲸鱼唱起好听的歌，听得鸟流下泪来（虽然他自己也不知道为什么）。

lines.en: "One day, you could meet my family in the ocean," said the whale.
lines.zh: “总有一天，你可以去海里见我的家人，”鲸鱼说。

lines.en: "And you could meet my friends on the land," said the bird.
lines.zh: “你也可以去陆地上见我的朋友，”鸟说。

lines.en: Everything was perfect.
lines.zh: 一切都美好极了。

lines.en: But the world does not stop turning just because a bird and whale fall in love.
lines.zh: 可是世界不会因为一只鸟和一头鲸鱼相爱就停止转动。

lines.en: Summer turned into autumn, and autumn turned into winter.
lines.zh: 夏天变成了秋天，秋天又变成了冬天。

lines.en: The ocean turned cold, and all the other whales left for warmer waters.
lines.zh: 海水变冷了，别的鲸鱼都动身去了温暖的海域。

lines.en: "Come with me to warmer waters," said the whale.
lines.zh: “跟我一起去温暖的海域吧，”鲸鱼说。

lines.en: "It’s a wonderful place.
lines.zh: “那是个好地方。

lines.en: It's always warm, and there are so many fish to eat."
lines.zh: 那儿总是暖暖的，还有好多鱼可以吃。”

lines.en: "I love to eat fish," said the bird.
lines.zh: “我爱吃鱼，”鸟说。

lines.en: "And I love you.
lines.zh: “我也爱你。

lines.en: I will follow you anywhere.
lines.zh: 你去哪儿我都跟着你。

lines.en: But first, teach me to be a whale?"
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，你能教我做一头鲸鱼吗？”

lines.en: "Like this!"
lines.zh: “就这样！”

lines.en: said the whale, "follow me!"
lines.zh: 鲸鱼说，“跟我来！”

lines.en: and she dived deep into the water.
lines.zh: 她一头扎进了深水里。

lines.en: "OK!"
said the bird, and he also dived deep into the water.
lines.zh: 鸟说着，也跟着扎进了深水里。

lines.en: Deeper and deeper he went.
lines.zh: 他越潜越深。

lines.en: "I'm swimming!"
lines.zh: “我在游泳啦！”

lines.en: he laughed.
lines.zh: 他笑着说。

lines.en: "I'm a whale!"
lines.zh: “我是鲸鱼啦！”

lines.en: But soon he couldn't breathe.
lines.zh: 可没过多久，他就喘不上气了。

lines.en: He returned to the surface, gasping.
lines.zh: 他浮回水面，大口大口地喘气。

lines.en: He tried and tried and tried again, but he ran out of breath every time.
lines.zh: 他试了一次又一次，可每一次都憋不住气。

lines.en: "I don't think a bird can become a whale," said the bird.
lines.zh: “我想，鸟是变不成鲸鱼的，”鸟说。

lines.en: "Come with me instead!
lines.zh: “那不如你跟我走吧！

lines.en: I live up on the cliffs.
lines.zh: 我住在悬崖上。

lines.en: It's a wonderful place.
lines.zh: 那是个好地方。

lines.en: It's warm and cosy, and every morning you can watch the sun rise."
lines.zh: 又暖和又舒服，每天早上还能看日出。”

lines.en: "I love to watch the sun rise," said the whale.
lines.zh: “我爱看日出，”鲸鱼说。

lines.en: "And I love you.
lines.zh: “我也爱你。

lines.en: I will follow you anywhere.
lines.zh: 你去哪儿我都跟着你。

lines.en: But first, teach me to be a bird?"
lines.zh: 不过在那之前，你能教我做一只鸟吗？”

lines.en: "Like this!"
lines.zh: “就这样！”

lines.en: said the bird.
lines.zh: 鸟说。

lines.en: "Follow me!"
lines.zh: “跟我来！”

lines.en: and he flapped his wings and soared into the sky.
lines.zh: 他扇动翅膀，飞上了天空。

lines.en: "OK!"
said the whale.
lines.zh: 鲸鱼说。

lines.en: She squeezed her eyes shut and flapped her fins, just like the bird.
lines.zh: 她紧紧闭上眼睛，像鸟那样拍打起自己的鳍。

lines.en: She flapped and flapped, up and down.
lines.zh: 她拍啊拍，上上下下地拍。

lines.en: Water splashed everywhere!
lines.zh: 水花溅得到处都是！

lines.en: "I'm flying!"
lines.zh: “我在飞啦！”

lines.en: she laughed.
lines.zh: 她笑着说。

lines.en: "I'm a bird!"
lines.zh: “我是鸟啦！”

lines.en: But when she opened her eyes, she wasn't soaring in the sky.
lines.zh: 可等她睁开眼睛，她并没有飞在天空里。

lines.en: She was still in the water.
lines.zh: 她还在水里。

lines.en: She tried and tried and tried again, but she could not fly.
lines.zh: 她试了一次又一次，可就是飞不起来。

lines.en: "I don't think a whale can become a bird," said the whale.
lines.zh: “我想，鲸鱼是变不成鸟的，”鲸鱼说。

lines.en: "But if you can't fly, and I can't swim, where can we live together?"
lines.zh: “可是你飞不起来，我也游不了，那我们能一起住在哪儿呢？”

lines.en: said the bird.
lines.zh: 鸟说。

lines.en: "We will stay here — in the waves!"
lines.zh: “我们就住在这儿吧——住在浪花里！”

lines.en: said the whale.
lines.zh: 鲸鱼说。

lines.en: But the bird shook his head sadly.
lines.zh: 可鸟难过地摇了摇头。

lines.en: "You love to swim deep in the ocean," he said.
lines.zh: “你最爱在大海里深深地游，”他说。

lines.en: That is your favourite thing to do.
lines.zh: 那是你最喜欢做的事。

lines.en: You would never be happy here."
lines.zh: 你在这儿是永远不会快乐的。”

lines.en: The whale sighed.
lines.zh: 鲸鱼叹了口气。

lines.en: "And you love to fly and soar into the sky," she said.
lines.zh: “而你最爱飞上天空、自在翱翔，”她说。

lines.en: "That is your favourite thing to do.
lines.zh: “那是你最喜欢做的事。

lines.en: You would never be happy here either."
lines.zh: 你在这儿也一样不会快乐。”

lines.en: And so, because the bird and whale loved each other so much, they said goodbye.
lines.zh: 就这样，因为鸟和鲸鱼是那样深爱着对方，他们说了再见。

lines.en: But they never forgot each other.
lines.zh: 但他们从来没有忘记过彼此。

lines.en: Every time the whale saw a bird flying high in the sky, she thought of her bird.
lines.zh: 每当鲸鱼看见一只鸟高高飞在天上，她就会想起她的那只鸟。

lines.en: She hoped he was enjoying the skies — just like that.
lines.zh: 她希望他正在天空里快快乐乐的——就像那样。

lines.en: And every time the bird saw a whale diving deep in the ocean, he thought of his whale.
lines.zh: 每当鸟看见一头鲸鱼深深潜入海里，他就会想起他的那头鲸鱼。

lines.en: He hoped she was enjoying the ocean — — just like that.
lines.zh: 他希望她正在大海里快快乐乐的——就像那样。
